dct_description_sm: This set presents public places and buildings and their main attributes such as their addresses and hours as well as the availability of facilities and amenities, especially in terms of universal accessibility services.**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**

Cet ensemble présente les lieux et bâtiments à vocation publique et leurs principaux attributs tels que leurs adresses et horaires ainsi que la disponibilité d'installations et de commodités, notamment en matière de services en accessibilité universelle.
